title: Swiss knowledge graph - sources on how the Confederation, cantons and communes share the tasks

scope.description: The constitutional division of competences and official plain-language overviews of Swiss federalism; everything else the graph cites is evidence the packs already carry.
exclusions: Pages a pack already cites: the graph cites those through the pack's evidence.

planning_topics.label: Federalism and the levels of the state

build_notes: Scouted and verified on 24 September 2026 by the graph-scout agent: every page carries its text in the server-rendered HTML.
The Fedlex filestore file of the consolidated version of 3 March 2024 holds the whole constitution; the 2029 expression is a future version and not used.
draft-2: the constitution is fetched through its undated ELI by the Fedlex plugin; the filestore file denies the downloader.

sources.title: Federal Constitution of the Swiss Confederation (BV), SR 101, consolidated version of 3 March 2024
sources.notes: Stable ELI; the Fedlex source plugin selects the consolidated version in force and its HTML. Arts. 3, 5a, 38, 42, 43a, 46, 49, 50, 62 and 121 state the division of competences.

evidence_selection_policy.eligibility: Apply explicit scope, jurisdiction, applicability, effective date and source language filters before ranking evidence.
evidence_selection_policy.ranking: Prefer the narrow official service page over a general landing page when both support the same statement.
evidence_selection_policy.duplicate_support: Related navigation pages do not count as independent corroboration. Retain the exact cited page and snapshot identity.
evidence_selection_policy.identity: Documents, snapshots, sections, evidence IDs, URLs, source languages and hashes remain independently identified.
evidence_selection_policy.answer_language: The calling LLM chooses the answer language and cites the selected original German evidence. English retrieval metadata is not factual evidence.

language_discovery.method: Inspect the saved page language and any visible language navigation. The official municipal pages selected for this MVP are published in German.
language_discovery.scope: New language URLs or hosts outside the explicit allowlist require a catalogue update before acquisition.
language_discovery.parallel_content: Every language version would receive its own snapshot, hashes and document identity; no translated routes are assumed.
language_discovery.selection_policy: Use the official German page. English concept labels and fact statements are editorial projections and never replace the cited German evidence.
